These are mandatory and can be practiced for a fee. Each turn corresponds to one month. In addition, the game offers a multiplayer mode, three launch scenarios, three difficulty levels and historical information about aircraft.

425273.overview:
Aliens TC is a total conversion of Doom based on the movie Aliens, created in 1994 by Justin Fisher.

It was the first total conversion and is one of the most famous. In the week following the release of Doom II, there was more discussion in the Doom newsgroups related to Aliens TC than to Doom II. The popularity of the TC even reached outside the Doom community, for instance providing inspiration for the 1998 Dreamworks game Trespasser. 

The original version of the mod was for Doom v1.2 and v1.666, with Ultimate Doom compatibility added later. Jason Mezzacca eventually created a version for use with Doom II. In addition to the replacement maps, textures, and sounds, the mod uses extensive DeHackEd modifications to create new weapons and monsters.

The Aliens TC is noted for its suspenseful atmosphere. The first level is devoid of enemies, a surprising feature considering the fast-paced action of Doom. Later on, however, the player faces the aliens and even gets to use the powerloader from Aliens as a weapon.

425285.overview:
Atonement is a 33-level megawad for Doom II made by Matthew DeCalzadilla (Moustachio). Developed and released over the course of five years, the project was first revealed on the Doomworld forums on July 31, 2017, with the initial release comprising three maps, while the full release followed on October 15, 2022. The mapset is divided into six episodes, with the first two episodes receiving a separate upload to the idgames archive on May 2, 2018, before the full release was added on November 28, 2022.

The mapset encompasses a wide variety of mapping styles, from minimaps to lengthy exploration-driven levels, and casual combat to light slaughter. The WAD makes use of the cc4-tex texture pack and features a custom soundtrack almost entirely made up of tracks by Dial-up for Murder, including six bespoke tracks commissioned for the set.

Atonement received an honorable mention at the 2022 Cacowards.

425298.overview:
Absolute Dishonor is a vanilla compatible eight-level Doom II episode replacement created by Michael Jan Krizik (valkiriforce) and Jon Vail (40oz). The WAD is inspired by old-school 1990's Doom WADs such as Memento Mori, The Plutonia Experiment, and Requiem, with each mapper contributing four maps to the project. 

The WAD was released on the Doomworld forums on August 14, 2016, and uploaded to the idgames archive on September 9.

425299.overview:
DOOM The Abyss, also known as The Abyss, is a 24-map megawad released in September 1995 for Doom II by J.M.P van Waveren (MrElusive) and Miklos de Rijk (H2SO4), co-creators of the Omicron Bot for Quake. As of this writing, The Abyss is their only known Doom work. The Abyss was relatively unknown for years after its release, and was never released in any known compilation, nor mentioned in any Usenet posts. It was rediscovered in the mid-2000s through a crawl of an id Software public staff server. The majority of the maps are non-linear "dungeons" which rely on secret passageways and switch puzzles, and have multiple paths that the player can take to complete a level.

After years of legal discussion going back to 2007, The Abyss was finally added to the idgames archive on September 1, 2015. While The Abyss was originally released on a BBS in the Netherlands, it was also available on the Telefragged FTP server for a short time in the directory /be/gladiator. It was later moved to a personal website. Previous versions are presumed to be lost due to link rot.

425342.overview:
Akeldama (AKELDAMA.WAD) is a vanilla-compatible megawad for Doom II that contains 32 new levels, uploaded to the idgames archive on June 1, 2020. It was made by several mappers, under the lead of Michael Jan Krizik (valkiriforce).

Akeldama was well-received upon release, but drew criticism for its lengthy levels and pacing. It received an honorable mention at the Cacowards in 2020.

425358.overview:
Anomaly Report is a vanilla-compatible megawad with 33 new levels designed by Michael Jan Krizik (valkiriforce) for Doom II, and published in April 2022. The levels are themed around a variety of visual styles, combining both outdoor and interior settings. It includes new graphics (a status bar by galileo31dos01 and a widescreen bar by NightFright), music, textures (remixed from Doom II, The Plutonia Experiment and TNT: Evilution), and a DeHackEd patch by OpenRift.

On July 5, 2022, Anomaly Report was added to the selected group of official add-ons for the Doom Classic Unity port, and it was selected as a runner-up at the 2022 Cacowards.

425792.overview:
Ancient Aliens is a 32-level megawad for Boom compatible source ports, created by Paul DeBruyne (skillsaw). It is a parody of alien conspiracy theories, particularly those from the TV show of the same name. The mapset features a large range of custom textures and a new palette, resulting in a distinct visual style. Also featured are several maps by guest level designers, mostly found in the third and final episode. The entirety of the soundtrack was composed by Stuart Rynn (stewboy), though several tracks were re-used from previous WADs. Late December 2022, the AA texture pack was updated to version 1.1, with the main WAD receiving the same texture updates.

The first release candidate of the WAD was released on 8 May, 2016. Just days ahead of the release of Doom (2016), the unveiling of a new high-quality megawad did not go unnoticed, and the WAD received widespread attention from gaming news sites. The final version was uploaded to the idgames archive on 19 July, 2016. It won a Cacoward that year.

In 2023, Ancient Aliens was included in Doomworld's Doot Eternal music feature for Doom's 30th anniversary.

438524.overview:
Digital Integration presents Apache Longbow- a stunning simulation of the world's most exciting combat helicopter. Take oft from your forward air base and fly into the thick of the action with a devastating array of lethal weapons at your fingertips.

    Instant battlefield action
    A vast selection of challenging realistic missions
    New 3D visual technology with incredible low-level detail
    Yemen. Korea and Cyprus- mapped from real terrain data
    Two player options- pilot/copilot, leader/wingman, head-to-head
    Networking for up to 16 players
    A must for all simulator enthusiasts and the gameplayer who enjoys an explosively good time!

Apache Longbow is the first genuine helicopter simulation to combine breathtaking 3D graphics, authenticity and ease of use. Climb aboard and experience what it's like to fly this awesome warrior.

453847.overview:
One of the few jumper simulators (horse riding with barriers) on a PC, created in Spain and published exclusively on the territory of this country. The text, if anything, is (except for a few words in the game interface) only in the menu.

The game itself is largely an arcade game - a side view, the control is quite simple (only three buttons are involved), the rider’s body position is not required to adjust, there is no choice of horses or jockeys either. Before starting the game using the R key, you can, unlike many Spanish games, adjust the control to your liking; function keys are responsible for running the horse (and at the same time for the start), jumping and pausing.

453862.overview: Alfred Pelrock is a guy with no seeming objective in his life until one night he awakens by a mysterious dream. An Egyptian princess has been held in a pyramid for eternity by his father, the pharaoh. So Alfred decides to travel to ancient Egypt to search for his 'beloved'.

453934.overview: A Spanish chess game developed and published by J.V. Enterprises in 1988.

453956.overview:
Adentrator is a horizontally-scrolling shooter. In this game, the player controls a spaceship and must eliminate the invading CyberDoids. The player has control over the ship’s speed, including the ability to stand still or turn around. The primary threat doesn’t come from enemy projectiles; instead, it arises from collisions with large enemy sprites or obstacles, especially when flying at high speeds. A single touch is fatal, and the player has a limited number of lives.

As the player progresses through the levels, they can collect power-ups that offer upgrades such as shields or improved weapons. The standard weapon can only fire one shot at a time, and the player must wait until it disappears before firing again.

453961.overview:
Accesinato is a freeware graphic adventure developed by ACCE (Cantabrian Association of Electronic Mail).
You are Pablo Telleria, a new member of ACCE, and you have agreed to spend a weekend in a remote house 40 kilometers from civilization. The party is going great, everyone is having fun, having a great time, but at the end of the party you discover Roman's corpse completely mutilated. There is a murderer in the house, it is one of you, he has punctured the tires of all the cars, there is no way out of that house, you cannot ask for help. You must discover who the murderer is, before he kills you all.

453998.overview: Our primary objectives are, on the one hand, to locate and rescue the crew members, and on the other, once the rescue work is complete, to kill the alien queen and escape by accessing the auxiliary ship.

454000.overview: This is version 2.0 of Akbarr, a game originally created for Spectrum, but which in this version has been converted to PC. The conversion has been done with the SKC parser by Ricardo Villalba. In this version many other things have also been added to improve the gameplay and give it a bit more humor, and the graphics have been completely changed.

454016.overview:
Aladino is an action game loosely based on the tale of Aladdin. The protagonist must recover a set of magic lamps hidden throughout each level and bring them to a waiting djinn, progressing through three stages and a final boss in order to rescue a captured girl.

Levels are presented in an isometric layout composed of interconnected rooms, each containing enemies, obstacles, and environmental objects. The player can move forward, turn left or right, and crouch, but cannot walk backward. To complete a level, all required lamps must be collected; some lie openly in rooms, while others are revealed by pushing barrels or stones. After the lamps are gathered, the player must locate the djinn to exit the level.

Enemies appear in increasing variety across stages—including rats, gangsters, scorpions, and later flying eyes—and reduce the player’s health on contact. Some can be avoided, while others are defeated using sword attacks. Certain jars provide special effects, such as healing or clearing all enemies in the room. Each level has a fixed time limit, and play ends if it expires.

454097.overview:
This game is free, in participation in the I Comedycomp 2001, so don't count on things happening exactly as in the movie, it may contain foul, vulgar and offensive language.

You play as Piley Ripley, captain of the space freighter "Bravos Astures VI", after the ex-captain Falconcrest contracted the disease of the mad onions on the planet Chivenutty III, and a draw was made by odd or even
numbers for the new leader.

You are in charge of a crew that is notable for its anarchistic and insane ailments, as well as for its uselessness. (Oh, you are also part of the crew, in case it wasn't implied).

454138.overview:
This is an adaptation of the module "The Pact" from the role-playing game "Aquelarre", by Ricard Ibañez.

According to the author "it is the typical story of rescuing a princess", but it must be added that it is one of the few stories set in medieval Spain.

454148.overview: Among all the fantastic stories that I have known, one of the ones that has fascinated me the most is that of the Master of the World, a little-known novel by Jules Verne but that contains all the adventure and anticipation of the future that characterize this author. The «Espanto», a mechanical device capable of running like a car at high speed, flying like an airplane, sailing like a ship and turning into a submarine when the occasion calls for it, constitutes a challenge to modern civilization that, in full space age, he has not yet been able to build a similar artifact and perhaps, whoever succeeds, has a huge chance of truly becoming Master of the World. The novel is about a series of mysterious phenomena such as earthquakes, strange lights and noises that begin in the crater of a dormant volcano called Great-Eyry. The chief inspector of the Washington police, John Strock, is in charge of revealing their nature and then a unique adventure begins that will lead him to discover the "Horror", the amazing machine created by Robur the Conqueror, and the base of this one inside the crater of Great-Eyry.

454266.overview:
Associe is an educative game for children (3-6 years). The goal of the game is quite simple, associate an object proposed by the computer with one of the objects in the lower grid. These objects must have a nexus (for example: wood with saw, carrot with rabbit.....). For this, the player must select, with the help of the cursors, the object of the grid that thinks is more suitable.

It is a multi-language game FR-EN-DE-IT-ES

454726.overview:
The Adventures of Max & Millie is an educational game aimed at children aged 5 to 8. The game combines elements of arcade-style gameplay with learning activities designed to develop mathematical and cognitive skills. Players solve puzzles that focus on recognizing attributes, grouping, sequencing, and continuing patterns.

The game encourages cooperation and teamwork while providing challenges to improve problem-solving and information-processing abilities. Through interactive gameplay, children are introduced to concepts such as working mathematically, understanding space, chance and data, and numbers.

455075.overview:
The Adventures Of Dianalee In The Lost temple Of The Aztecs is a shareware, single player, two dimensional, platform game.

The story behind the game is simple. Diana is sitting in her class at school. It's time for the teacher to hand out homework, some students get maths, some get essays, Dianalee's assignment is to find 'The Orb of Destiny'. The game starts when Diana has parachuted into the jungle. First the player must explore the Aztec pyramid to find the entrance and once inside they leap from platform to platform looking for items and killing baddies with their whip.

The game is keyboard controlled, has a high score and sound.

The shareware release of the game contains only episode one, the registered version of the game contains two more.

455243.overview:
Alchemyst is a single-player, shareware, block moving puzzle game. Alchemy is about turning base metal into gold and that's the theme of this puzzle game, or rather turning blue/gray blocks to yellow ones.

The game is entirely controlled by the mouse. The game area consists of a series of rows of blue/gray blocks, all the same size. There is one row of blocks at the top of the screen set apart from the rest and this contains some yellow blocks, clicking on this row causes the blocks within it to move one cell to the left with the left most cell 'wrapping round.

The player shifts these blocks around until they are happy with the desired pattern, and they click on one of the other rows on the screen. This transfers the blocks from the top row to the selected row. If a yellow block replaces a blue/gray block this is a good move, if a yellow block replaces an existing yellow block the result is that the block reverts to a blue/gray block. The game's objective is to repeat this process until all the lower rows contain nothing but yellow blocks.

The player can select different combinations of row size and height which affects the game's difficulty and the game records the highest score for each. There are optional sound effects and an in-game help file.

The game is played against a photographic background. Standard registration cost $5, but the purchaser could pay $20 to have the game customized so that it played over a photograph they supplied with their registration fee.

455818.overview:
Humanity lost the big war against the alien empire and had to leave Earth and its solar system behind. Now, after over three hundred of hard life inside of space stations, they managed to build a small fleet of space ships and set out to find a new planet to call their own and destroy the empire in the process. The player takes the role of one of those ships.

Abaron is a vertically scrolling shooter: the player can move the space ship in four directions, shoot the equipped weapon in order to kill alien ships and dodge their bullets to avoid losing the ship's life-energy. Extra equipment has to be purchased by collecting credits chips which are left behind by pre-determined enemies. Depending on how many were gathered, another weapon is available for purchase with a button press, e.g. three credits give a pulse laser and seven credits a shield. Some of the weapons can be upgraded by buying them more than once and if the player has bought multiple weapons, they can be cycled through. When more than ten credits are collected, the count is set to zero and extra points for the high-score are rewarded; another way to improve the high score is to collect stars which are randomly left behind by killed enemies. The ship has only one life and there are no continues, but the game can be saved at the beginning of each level.

455999.overview:
Ants: The Exodus is a single player strategy game with 25 levels and a level editor. You control an ant, and need to guide all four princess ants to the exit safely. You do this by collecting and placing various objects, such as direction arrows and blocks. There is a time limit for each level.

Items include arrows (that force travel along a given path), bridges (to cross gaps), dynamite (to destroy blocks and enemies), mines (to destroy enemies), keys and locked doors, webs (that will trap you), and holes (that you can fall in).

456037.overview: Adidas Power Soccer is a sports game that simulates soccer. While it has the option to play in simulation mode, it is best remembered for the Arcade mode and the trademark move of the game - the Predator Shot (named after the most popular brand of boots manufactured by the German company). In this mode, all special moves are unlocked, and some of them allow to go way beyond what rules allow. Four cameras allow us to follow the motion-captured action as best as possible. Commentary is available in English, German, and French.

456047.overview: The Adventures of Nikko is an interactive book where, in each chapter, players are given two choices (e.g., whether Nikko is a prince or an elephant), shaping the narrative accordingly. Players can interact with the screen to activate animations before proceeding to the next chapter. Completed stories can be printed out as coloring books.
456047.developer: Centre for Educational Technology and Plastronics

456098.overview: Astatin is a puzzle game where players recreate a pattern displayed on the right-hand side of the screen. To achieve this, players place stones on a grid by clicking on specific fields. Once a stone is placed on a neighboring field, previously positioned stones transform in both form and color. The order of stone placement varies with each level and is indicated at the bottom of the screen. Players must solve each level within a time limit; failure to do so results in the loss of a life. When all lives are depleted, players either restart from the beginning or re-enter at specific levels (5, 10, 15...) using a password.

456108.overview:
America Adventure is another solid title in Knowledge Adventure's somewhat popular series based on Knowledge Adventure engine.

In this title, you will learn about the geography, history, and general trivia involving the United States. In addition to a decent database that is packed with interesting factoids, America Adventure also includes a number of mini-games such as guess the capital city - none of which is particularly engaging, however. If you have tried any other title in this series, you will be familiar with the interface. A photo screen occupies the right half of the screen, while the information box, the map, and menu icons lined up around it. You use the map and accompanying timeline to choose the time period and location in the USA you want to read about, and each photo has a number of "hot spots" you can click on to bring up related subjects.

All in all, a decent title that offers enough trivia about the USA to occupy you for a while, although the games could be much better and the database more comprehensive.

456238.overview: Based on the board game of the same name, two to four players are required to build hotels along a boardwalk in Atlantic City, New Jersey. The hotels are constructed by placing markers that represent the growing floors of the hotels. The game progresses when players throw three dice, two standard numeric six-sided dice, and a special color die. The two numbers on the standard dice represents the total amount of money players can spend on construction, while the special die tells them that they can build in any color group. During the game, players can take over each other's hotels and get Fortune Cards, in which players can take advantage of construction bonuses, natural disasters, and other events to add and remove floors. As with the board game, the first player to pass $35 million in hotel property values wins the game.

456262.overview: Across the USA is an educational game about the geography of the USA. It teaches locating states on the US map, the official abbreviations of states, and their capitals. All three activities can be selected directly from the main menu. Each activity is based on the same concept: a state is highlighted in red on the US map and the player has to input the abbreviation, name of the state or capital. If the player starts with a wrong letter, the correct one is shown and then the remainder can be guessed. Correct ones are marked in green. When unsure the state can be skipped and will be marked in grey. It will be shown again when all other states have been presented. Additional information can be displayed such as the population and size. The game has options for outlining words, using upper or lower case letters, and a fixed or random order. It keep tracks of statistics such as time elapsed, amount of words done and skipped, number of correct characters, number of key strokes and efficiency.

456264.overview:
Adventureland is the first of Scott Adams' text adventures. Using simple two word commands you explore an enchanted world, solve puzzles and try to recover 13 lost treasures.

The game's display is different from other adventure games like Zork: The Great Underground Empire in that the screen is divided into two "windows": the room description, exits, and items appear on the top part of the screen, and you enter commands on the bottom of the screen.

456311.overview:
ALF, a furry alien who for fear of discovery can't really leave the house, is Vision Software's choice to teach children about the wide range of geographical features found in the United States.

Lesson one: A multiple choice quiz to test knowledge of geographical terminology. Hosted by ALF, who fires a cannon (!) containing your answer choice at a bucket.

Lesson two: ALF quizzes you on the names and/or capitals of states highlighted on a map of the 48 contiguous states (the packaging claims this lesson covers all 50.)

Lesson three: ALF now quizzes you on landmarks' locations.

Lesson four: a simple timeline of the admission of states into the union.

Lesson five: Allows children to make a personalized print-out of events with historical and personal relevance.

456355.overview:
Enjoy the most realistic aircraft handling ever achieved on a PC based flight simulation with the totally rewritten flight models of MD-83, MD-88 and B747-400. Three years of research result in highly sophisticated flight equations based on true inertia system, true airflow calculations, detailed calculations of forces even down to tyre deformations, that warrant an astonishingly realistic behaviour of the airplane, both in ground and airborne handling. Revised atmosphere and grossly enhanced weather effects like wind turbulence, rain, snow as well as runway surface calculation allow realistic ground handling in steady or gusty crosswind, taking into account dry, wet, snowy or icy runways. Explore the edges of the airplane envelope ... Want to see, whether you can loop or roll your favourite airliner? Good luck! Stress calculations will give you an idea when your aircraft disintegrates in the air - however, aircraft will maintain flyable, but you will need to deal with asymmetric lift, asymmetric drag, flamed out engines and much more, if you overstress the airframe, as you may loose parts of your wings, slats, flaps, tailplane or cause engine failures. Touch down hard, and experience the skidding experience with a partly collapsed gear.

Aircraft Abstraction layer, short AAL, the technology behind the new flight model, makes flying easy, as airplanes are designed to be flown by average pilots, and teaches the right, real world handling techniques used by real world pilots. Be ahead of your airplane, that's the key to success in flying your aircraft - the inertia of the plane now forces you to think ahead of your airplane, just as real aircraft do.

And of course, who wants to fly the famous Dumbo will be able to do so, too.

AS2 features all systems, that the handling pilot will have to deal with, including fully featured Autopilot and Main Control Panel (MCP), Flight Management Computer (FMS), Thrust Computer, Ground Proximity Warning System (GPWS), Traffic and Collision Avoidance System (TCAS) and many more systems. The handling Pilot will be relieved from handling other systems by the virtual first officer, who therefore takes care your workload as flying pilot will not become critical - as in the real plane.

Aural Alarms (e.g. GPWS, TCAS, configuration alarms), voice communication with the first officer and improved sounds for touch down, stall warning and other aircraft related sounds have been implemented using real world sounds.

AS2 comes with a 300 pages manual in printed form (150 pages thereof being reproductions of Aerad Airport and ILS charts), teaching all relevant methods of handling an airplane, not only in windless situations, but crosswind, gusty winds, windshear and all levels of turbulences, that make an ILS approach in clouds really demanding. In addition three reproductions of Aerad enroute charts covering Europe and North Atlantic come with AS2, as well as laminated checklists for the MD-83, MD-88 and B744.

456366.overview: In Amagedon: Hondon Sog-Eulo........, players embark on a mission to reclaim Earth from attackers. It is based on the animated movie Armageddon, but features no in-game story except an introductory and concluding movie, along with brief mission briefings. During missions, players control a spaceship in a first-person view. The 11 missions typically involve eliminating specific enemies, occasionally under a time limit or while protecting another ship. There is no free movement through space; players use a crosshair to aim their equipped weapon and rotate the ship 360 degrees. Enemy positions are displayed on a radar. Between missions, players can utilize acquired funds to purchase new ships, weapons, and ammunition, as well as enhance their energy, defense, and offensive capabilities. Saving progress between missions is possible, but frequent reloading boost enemy stats and may lead to an assault.

456488.overview:
Adventure Writer is the US version of The Quill, a program for creating text adventures. Compared to the original UK version, it features a new manual, support for graphics (only on Commodore 64 and Apple II), support for both 40-column and 80-column text (only on DOS), and—most importantly—the demo game Rescue.

The goal is to find and rescue the princess by exploring the environment, collecting items, and using them to overcome obstacles and solve puzzles. Players interact with the game by writing commands into the parser.

456495.overview: "Averno" is the Spanish adaptation of the skill game Neptune, originally released for the MSX computer. In both the adaptation and the original, the character must be guided through a maze, collecting items to advance through the level. One of the game's unique features is the ability to advance by moving blocks that block the way, allowing you to create shortcuts to obtain these items.

456509.overview:
Alpha Build is an educational game that teaches alphabet skills to children. The player controls a penguin called Perry who has to climb ladders to pick up letters and then drop them onto the correct truck. The aim of the game is to build a city and to do so three sets of trucks have to be loaded with letters. Each stage involves loading eight trucks which will then drive away and construct the city. First the frame is built, then the surface and finally it is coloured.

There are eight levels of play. The first four levels involve simple letter recognition, upper and lower case matching and alphabetical order. Level 5 adds words to the game while level 6 to 8 are word challenges in which some of the needed letters are hidden.

456513.overview:
Alge-Blaster Plus! is the second game in the Alge-Blaster series of educational games that teaches algebra. This version consists of five activities:

Learn gives instructions step by step on how to solve the various problems that the player comes across.
Solve is essentially the same as the original Alge-Blaster. The player gets to solve ten algebra problems and will then get a result at the end. It can be played with or without hints.
Translate gives the player a phrase and the player has to choose the corresponding expression from a list of four. It can also be vice versa with the player having to pick the phrase that matches the expression.
Graph shows a grid with a number of dots and the player either has to enter the coordinates of a dot or find the dot that corresponds with the coordinates given.
Alge-Blaster Game is a science fiction themed game played on a grid similar to the previous activity. The player's task is to protect a space station from asteroids which is done by controlling four laser cannons located in the corners of the grid. These are then controlled by entering slopes (for example 2/3). In addition to shooting the asteroids it's possible to block them by constructing webs. This is done by entering the two pairs of coordinates that the web should stretch between.
The following subjects are included in the game:

Integers
Order of Operations
Monomials & Polynomials
Factoring
Equations
Systems of Equations
Algebraic Fractions
Radicals
Quadralic Equations

456520.overview:
The very first game by Villa Crespo Software, founded by Dan Sejzer in Highland Park, IL. 'Real Poker' bears the name of professional gambler 'Amarillo Slim' (Thomas Preston), better known by his 'appearance' in later products of the same company, Amarillo Slim Dealer's Choice and Amarillo Slim's 7 Card Stud.

As could be seen from the title, Amarillo Slim’s Real Poker – Five Card Stud presents but one variety of poker, 5 card stud. There is no graphics, as everything including the cards is pictured by text symbols, but the game features friendly interface, extensive help system and such options as 'tutor' and 'odds' aimed at assisting the novice players. Only one of four participants could be human, but there is a possibility to disable one or two extra computer opponents.

456521.overview:
23rd-century Earth is a good place to be: after an atypically friendly first contact with an alien species, the planet's ills have been cured and peace reigns supreme. But some will always resist change, let alone utopian ideas. One such organization was the innocently-named American Neutral Investigators, and its leader Mapier was exiled off-planet for disturbing the peace. This decision did not prove far-sighted however; Mapier worked diligently, pirating and destroying, harvesting debris, alien technology and raw materials, and gradually built up a huge armed space fortress from which the ANI continue to terrorize known space.

This is where the player comes in, piloting an infiltrator ship into the bowels of the ANI's Mapierian Anti-Complex (ANIMAC) to find and destroy the central command. The meandering tunnels burrowing through the planet-sized base consist of hundreds of different rooms, littered with automated defenses, mines and hostile drones, while the Infiltrator only packs a single forward-firing photon launcher. Bridges and invisible warps complicate matters further, as does the security system which makes backtracking a deadly risk.

456527.overview:
Alphabet Zoo is a top-view educational game where the player races around a maze. It is up to the player to collect the letters scattered around. The maze also contains two teleporters that warp the player who uses them to a random spot.

Each maze has a graphic representation of an object in the middle. There are two modes: Game 1, where the player needs to repeatedly collect first letter of the object's name as many times as possible within the time limit, and Game 2, where all the letters of the name must be collected in the correct order. The game can be played in one-player mode, or with two competing players. The game allows to start from any level and choose uppercase letters only, lowercase letters only, or a mix of both.

456539.overview: Amy's First Primer is a collection six early learning mini-games to teach young users navigation, logic, counting and ABCs. During gameplay the game will not criticise for any mistakes made, allowing for the player to experiment with the keyboard until the right answer is found. For the second, third and fourth activities completed successfully, the player will be treated to the ABC song, while the last two activities remain continuous.

456564.overview:
Runaway is set in a distant future where illegal organizations have seized large parts of the galaxy. The galaxy’s government dispatched spies, but unfortunately, they were captured and sent to a high-security prison on Ari, Greece. Now, the player assumes control of one of these spy units and must escape the solar system.

The game is a horizontally scrolling shooter featuring 13 levels and 5 bosses. To survive, the player must shoot down enemies and avoid their projectiles, as each contact reduces the life bar. When the life bar is empty, one of live is lost, and the game ends when all lives are gone. Throughout the levels, power-ups appear, granting ship upgrades (such as a protective satellite, improved weapons, or additional speed) or money. Players can use money to purchase upgrades or extra lives between levels.

457794.overview: One of the many versions of the classic Pac-Man that differs from the original in its use of a multicoloured background, an eater character, wandering fruits and changing maze layouts. In addition, various melodies are played in the background, the set of which and a different type of maze can be selected in the available game options. In general, the player's task is to rescue Ms A-Pac, who has been kidnapped by the ghosts. To do this, you need to eat all the dots on the board in order to move on to the next level, and there are 14 of them in total. Eating larger dots gives you a temporary opportunity to eat the intrusive ghosts.

458034.overview: Algebra Arcade is an educational game which despite its title is not an arcade game. It does include some aliens however and these appear on a coordinate grid. The player's task is to zap as many of these so called algebroids as possible and this is done by typing in equations. When the entered equation is plotted a whirlwind will follow its path and knock off any algebroids that it passes through. For each algebroid that is taken out the player earns some points. At the same time it is necessary to avoid the ghost that is also located on the grid. If it is hit the Graph Gobbler will appear and munch the equation and the player will be without any points. The player will also be sent to a committee which can penalize the player by taking away some turns. The game can be played by one or two players who each has ten turns. Extra turns are given for scoring 10,000 points, clearing all the algebroids or by finding the Graph Gobbler which is invisible on the grid.

458043.overview: Alex the Allegator is an unfinished platformer created during a game jam. In this game, players assume control of Alex, an alligator on a quest to find his missing girlfriend. Although enemies and obstacles have not been fully implemented, the game is functional. Players guide Alex through the level, helping him reach the goal by exploring and occasionally jumping between platforms. Additionally, the game features cooperative multiplayer, although there is no split-screen functionality, and the camera remains focused on the first player.

458450.overview:
Winner of the 1st National Adventure Contest organized by the CAAD (National Association of Adventurers).

The story takes place in the 24th century, where we end up after falling into a cryogenic freezing capsule.
The world we wake up to is far from what we remembered, with cities ruled by machines that decide our fate.

In the city we're about to land in, there has been an earthquake that has damaged the mainframe. Our mission is to repair the computer and restore order.

458558.overview: A Spanish language text Adventure\interactive fiction game from 2000.

458562.overview: This game is a classic within the text adventure genre.

459131.overview: A supercomputer in the most remote part of a distant galaxy has become crazy and threatens to destroy the planet. You have been chosen to be the central link of the support command which will try to give a solution for it. But don't worry, you have been educated and trained in the Golden Ring space station, the hardest survival school of the galactic confederation. Besides, your ship is equipped with the ultimate devices which will allow you to travel safely by the well-known universe. The Combat Mode, where you can activate a panel with a system to locate and to destroy your enemies and the Control System via Menus, both make La Aventura Espacial a new concept in the graphic-conversational adventure. First of all, your mission is to find your companions, whom are distributed by all the universe, and together with them you must arrive to the central base of the Dark Threat. There, you will have to deal one on one with the computer. It's not an easy task, but you are the last hope of the humanity. All the galaxy has its destiny in your hands.

464246.overview:
Acquire is a computer adaptation of the board game of the same name. Players take the role of investors competing to build and expand hotel chains on a shared grid. By founding chains, influencing their growth and benefiting from mergers, players work to accumulate the greatest wealth before the game concludes.

The game takes place on a 12×10 grid where players place one tile each turn. Tile placement may start a chain, enlarge an existing one or trigger a merger. After placing a tile, players may purchase shares in active chains, with prices determined by chain size.

Mergers award majority and minority bonuses, and shareholders decide how to trade, sell or keep stock from absorbed chains. Players always maintain six tiles in hand, drawing replacements at the end of each turn. Tiles that would connect permanent chains become dead tiles and may be discarded.

The game ends when a chain reaches a large threshold size or all tiles have been drawn. Final bonuses are awarded, shares are sold and the richest player wins.

464286.overview:
Air Troubles: Search for the Hero of Mount Mistake is a competitive two-player aerial combat game played on a single static screen. Each player flies a small propeller aircraft and uses separate controls for accelerating, braking, climbing, and descending. Planes cannot freely rotate; instead, movement is governed by thrust and vertical adjustment.

Before each match, players choose one of several secondary weapons in addition to the standard forward-firing cannon. A round ends when one aircraft is shot down or crashes into the terrain. The overall match is awarded to the first player to win five rounds. The game contains no single-player mode.

464287.overview:
Air-Strike is a fixed-position shoot ’em up in which the player controls a rotating gun turret located at the bottom center of the screen. Using the mouse to adjust the turret’s firing angle, the player shoots approaching aircraft and descending parachutists before they can reach the ground. Enemies include several types of planes and helicopters, some dropping paratroopers or bombs and others delivering power-ups.

The game features six selectable weapons—machine gun, double machine gun, laser, flame thrower, grenade launcher, and homing missiles—which can be acquired or cycled during play. Four different scenario backgrounds are included: rolling hills, a fiery underworld, snowy mountains, and a lunar surface. The game contains four levels and displays blood effects when enemies are hit. Prompts are available in multiple languages, including French, German, Spanish, and Esperanto.

464289.overview:
Airstrike follows an Apache-style attack helicopter deployed by the North Atlantic Defence Alliance in a conflict against the nation of Dosnovia. Operating from an offshore aircraft carrier, the pilot receives mission briefings that outline specific enemy targets scattered across coastal defenses, inland settlements, and military installations. Performance is evaluated after each mission, with commendations for precision and reprimands for unnecessary destruction.

Players control a helicopter in a horizontally scrolling environment, flying over looping terrain while engaging designated objectives. Enemy forces include soldiers armed with missiles, gunboats, anti-aircraft guns, radar stations, and missile batteries positioned among civilian structures. Points are awarded for destroying legitimate military targets, while damaging neutral elements such as trees reduces the score.

Missions progress through a sequence of twenty-one stages. The helicopter can land on the carrier when it reappears at the end of the scrolling map, automatically replenishing ammunition and repairing damage. Failed missions may be retried, though choosing to abandon one returns the player partway back through the mission list.

464292.overview:
Aktie-Bal is a real-time puzzle game in which the player controls a rolling ball that must collect all flags and reach the exit within a time limit on each level. The ball cannot jump, so the player uses movements one tile at a time to navigate platforms and hazards. 

Levels contain obstacles such as fire that cause the player to lose a life on contact, elevators that transport the ball between floors, and collectible bombs used to destroy certain walls blocking progress. Bombs are limited and must be placed strategically, as incorrect use can force restarts. Each of the three episodes contains 25 levels; later episodes are unlocked after purchasing the full version.

464306.overview:
Alchemy is a puzzle game built around combining elemental components to create increasingly complex substances. At the start of a session, the player is given a set of primary elements represented as icons. By dragging one element onto another, the player attempts to trigger a reaction that forms a new object, substance, or natural phenomenon. Many combinations require more than two components, and some results can be created through multiple different recipes.

Newly discovered items can be used as ingredients for further reactions or dismantled back into simpler elements under certain conditions. Not every pairing produces an effect, and experimentation is the central mechanic. The player can request additional base elements at any time. There is no fixed win condition; progress consists of discovering all possible combinations.

464319.overview:
Alien Assault II is set in a human outpost overrun by hostile alien creatures. A lone soldier is deployed into the base to clear infested corridors and reach a teleporter that leads to the next sector.

Alien Assault II is a top-down shooter in which the player navigates a maze of narrow corridors filled with alien enemies. The soldier begins with a machine gun, while additional weapons and equipment can be purchased at computer terminals using credits found during play. Terminals also display the current map, statistics, and various control functions such as turning off lights or reversing one-way floor tiles.

Progression through each of the game’s four levels requires locating keycards to open locked doors, collecting ammunition and medikits, and reaching the teleporter that ends the stage. Aliens attack on sight, depleting the player’s health, and supplies are limited, requiring careful use of resources while moving through the base.

464345.overview: All-American College Football is an updated version of the 1993 game of the same name. Besides adding the team rosters of the 1992 season (and the option to download 1993 data), the main addition are the new match graphics: now the field scrolls horizontally instead of vertically. The match interface is also new.

464349.overview: All-American College Football is an updated version of the 1991 game of the same name. Besides the team rosters of the 1992 and 1993 season, the main additions are a new graphical interface (the predecessor uses mostly standard DOS tables) and a new graphical match representation with 3D models instead of a top-down view.

464410.overview:
Amy’s Fun-2-3 Adventure! places players in a series of child-friendly number-based activities guided by Amy, an animated puppy. The program combines counting, number matching, music, and simple problem-solving in a set of mini-games designed to introduce early math concepts through visual and auditory feedback. 

The game comes with four different minigames:

- Counting Mode: The player selects a number, and Amy demonstrates it through actions such as jumping or barking that number of times. 
- Match Machine: A number is shown alongside groups of items. The player chooses the group whose count matches the number, earning a treat for Amy when correct. 
- Music Mode: A simple xylophone interface allows the player to play notes or follow along with songs, reinforcing number recognition through musical interaction. 
- Cookie Castle: The player helps rebuild a castle by placing blocks in positions corresponding to numbers indicated by Amy, combining counting with object placement.

464429.overview:
Like the first set, this installment features two games that flex the player's mathematical skills. This time both are based on puzzles, which must be solved within the chosen number of turns (at adjustable difficulty levels).

Discovery Machine: one or two players face off against the titular apparatus, which takes a number, applies a hidden formula and prints the result. The contraption displays a sample input/output pair, and your task is to find out the formula. For each input shown, you'll have to guess the result; if you get it right three times in a row, you win.

Number Chase: a Mastermind-style code-breaking game - the player has to guess a series of digits, and gets an evaluation after each turn. Two human opponents may play each other; in the single-player version, the computer can (optionally) join in as an AI opponent, and take a stab at guessing the human player's number on its own.

464448.overview:
Around the World: Cristmas is a 2D side-scrolling platform game in which the player controls Wolf through level-based stages viewed from the side. The objective is to traverse each level while jumping across platforms, avoiding hazards, and dealing with enemies.

The game introduces two snow-themed levels that affect movement physics, causing Wolf to slide on snowy surfaces. Collectible items appear as presents, and enemies are represented by Christmas-themed characters such as Santa Claus and snowmen. Aside from these thematic and environmental changes, the gameplay systems, controls, and progression function in the same manner as in Around the World.

464464.overview:
Asteroid Impact is a fixed-perspective space shooter in which the player controls a spacecraft orbiting Earth. The ship rotates around the planet but does not move freely through open space. Incoming asteroids and alien threats approach from all directions, and the player must fire weapons to destroy these dangers before they impact the planet.

Players fire at asteroids and enemies while avoiding collisions that deplete shield energy. The ship carries a limited number of smart bombs that, when used, destroy all threats currently on screen. Defeating alien enemies can leave behind stars that increase the strength of the ship’s gun. The objective is to survive as long as possible and achieve a high score by eliminating asteroids and enemy ships.

464498.overview:
Astro Blaster places the player in control of a spaceship positioned at the bottom of a single-screen playfield. The ship can move horizontally from left to right while waves of enemy ships approach from above. The player fires weapons to destroy enemies while avoiding incoming laser fire.

Fuel is limited, and firing weapons consumes it. Excessive weapon use causes the ship’s weapons to overheat, temporarily disabling firing until they cool down. The ship is also equipped with a limited time warp ability that slows enemy movement for a short duration. A wave ends when all enemies are destroyed or when the player successfully avoids them and their attacks, after which the next wave begins. The game continues until the player loses all available lives.

466101.overview:
ABC Fun Keys is an educational game for young children aged between two and six.

There are four games in the product;

* The Entry Level is a simple game which shows a picture and plays a song whenever a key is pressed
* The Beginner's game is a variation on the first game, now the game plays a song and shows a picture and the child must press the corresponding key
* The Advanced is the same as Beginner's game with the twist that the picture is revealed gradually
* The final game is a typing tutor where letters float in mid air 'between heaven and mud'. The child must type the word correctly before the letters fall into the mud, if they are successful the letters are, and this comes straight from the game description, "hearted to heaven".

466110.overview:
A two-player aerial duel. The dogfight commences inside a wrap-around, top-down playfield, as each side tries to gun down the opponent's plane. Game parameters are highly configurable, with adjustable values for physics and player variables; on-screen indicators help keep track of lives, power, ammo and damage during battle.

Written in tribute to Iron Maiden and their song Aces High, the game also features a cover of the song (in .MOD format) as its background music.

466150.overview:
Adventure Game Studio is a game creation program used to develop 2D point-and-click adventure games in the style of classic Sierra On-Line titles. It provides an integrated development environment that combines room editors, sprite and animation handling, dialogue systems, and a scripting language used to define game logic and interactions. Games created with the system typically use mouse-driven exploration, character-based interaction, inventory puzzles, and screen-based environments.

The program ships with a built-in demonstration adventure game designed to showcase these features. The demo presents a playable scenario in which the player navigates through several connected screens and solves a small number of puzzles to open a closed door at the end of the game area. Interaction is handled through a four-icon interface—walk, look, use, and talk—cycled with the right mouse button, closely resembling Sierra’s SCI engine conventions.

466363.overview:
Air Attack! is an arcade game set over a series of cities viewed from a side perspective. The player takes the role of a bomber aircraft descending through urban skylines, with progression tied to clearing enough of each cityscape to continue onward.

The player pilots a bomber that continuously moves horizontally while gradually losing altitude. Buildings rise from the bottom of the screen, and the player drops bombs to destroy them and carve a safe path forward. Only a single bomb can be active at a time, making timing and positioning central to play. Each city forms a self-contained screen, and advancement depends on removing sufficient obstacles before the aircraft descends into them. The game ends upon collision with the environment.

466381.overview:
Alien River is a strategy game set on a desolate plain near the Pecos River, where an alien space vessel has crash-landed. Several surviving aliens are roaming the area surrounding the wreckage and are reported to be extremely hostile. The player is deployed near an abandoned settlement on the opposite side of the river with orders to reach the crash site and inspect the remains of the alien craft. The environment includes ruined buildings and a river separating the player’s starting position from the objective, shaping the danger and movement of both the player and the aliens.

The game is played on a top-down, grid-based map and proceeds in turns. Each time the player makes a move or performs an action, all aliens simultaneously advance one step toward the player’s current position. The objective is to reach the alien ship while avoiding direct contact with the pursuing aliens.

To slow or eliminate enemies, the player can place landmines on the terrain. Placing a mine consumes a turn, allowing the aliens to move closer, but detonates when an alien steps on it. The player begins with a limited supply of mines, with additional mines obtainable from a randomly placed crate on the map.

466384.overview: Christoph Röschter's Aliens is a horizontally-scrolling shooter. The player takes control over a soldier with a jetpack who faces a lot of alien opposition. The soldier is moved over the screen with the mouse (without animations) and shoots enemies with a machine gun. Unfortunately ammo is limited and when it runs out, the soldier is completely defenseless.   Additionally your sprite is fairly large, which makes it difficult to avoid all of the incoming fire and hazards.

466406.overview:
AllegroHack is a graphical roguelike game based on 1987 NetHack. The player assumes the role of an adventurer descending through a fantasy dungeon in search of the Amulet of Yendor. The dungeon is populated by monsters, items, traps, and magical effects, and progression requires surviving increasingly dangerous dungeon levels before returning to the surface with the amulet. The narrative structure and setting follow those of NetHack without modification.

Gameplay in AllegroHack follows the turn-based dungeon exploration mechanics of NetHack. The player moves through randomly generated dungeon levels, engaging in combat with monsters, collecting and identifying items, managing hunger and status effects, and interacting with environmental features such as doors, traps, and altars. Character progression is influenced by race, role, alignment, and equipment choices.

AllegroHack replaces the traditional ASCII display with a graphical tile-based interface rendered using the Allegro library. Dungeon elements, monsters, and items are represented by large color graphics, while the underlying rules, systems, and interactions remain unchanged from NetHack.

470485.overview:
Adskok is an unofficial adaptation of Адскок (1990) for the Russian computer Vector-06C. In this version, the gameplay remains faithful to the original, with levels loosely based on the original design.

The game features single-room levels that must be crossed unharmed to progress to the next level. These levels are constructed vertically, so after moving from left to right, the main character uses a ladder to reach an upper platform and then proceeds to walk to the left. Unlike traditional platformers, there is no jumping involved; the primary danger comes from enemies that move up and down. Successfully bypassing these enemies requires precise timing, as once the character starts walking, he only stops after climbing a ladder. However, players can change the horizontal direction of movement at any time.

Upon touching an enemy, the player loses a life and instantly respawns at the start of the level. If all lives are lost, a password is provided, allowing the player to resume from the last reached level.

474360.overview: Aardvark's Museum (commonly known in retro computing archives simply as Museum) is a classic text adventure game released around 1987. It is most famous in vintage computing circles not for a massive retail release, but for being one of the definitive showcase games written in ADL (Adventure Definition Language) by developer Ross Cunniff.

474361.overview:
ABC Talk It was heavily marketed for featuring a "real human voice". In 1993, hearing an actual digitized human voice clip instead of robotic PC-speaker bleeps was a massive technical feature for early childhood software.  

It taught young children how to talk, memorize the alphabet, read, spell, and learn the basics of operating an IBM PC keyboard. It also included a creative feature allowing children to construct colorful abstract "collages" and "kaleidoscopes" using letters and basic geometric graphics on the screen.

474726.overview:
Reon-ui Moheom ("Leon's Adventure") is a side-scrolling action platform game featuring an anthropomorphic lion as a protagonist. The plot revolves around a contest that will determine the new king of all animals. The protagonist sets out to compete, and will have to overcome various obstacles in his way.

The game plays in a fashion rather similar to Sonic the Hedgehog. Leon can jump, run and attack enemies at close range. Continuously pressing the run button speeds him up which is important because the levels are timed. Opposing the protagonist are various other anthropomorphic animals and even plants, each type with its own distinct behaviour and attack. Sometimes the enemies drop powerups when disposed of, including extra time added to the timer. Like Sonic, Leon collects golden rings, but here these can be used to purchase powerups between levels.

475250.overview:
Artillery Combat is an artillery game for 2 players.

The goal is, of course, to destroy the other player's artillery by calculating angles and speed plus the wind direction and strength and then launch the missile.
Every player has a certain amount of men and per shot 10 men will leave. Men will also be killed at impact. Whoever loses all men first loses the match, even if both artilleries are still standing.

477656.overview:
"Action Worm is an independent, retro-styled arcade game released in 2013. Built as a pure homage to the classic Nibbles and Snake games of the early home computing era, the game deliberately abandons modern visual engines in favor of a minimalist, early 1980s text-mode computer presentation.

Players control a continuously moving worm rendered as a solid white line grid avatar, navigating a pitch-black digital screen matrix. The objective is to eat scattered red square pixel blocks to grow the worm's length and accumulate points, while strictly avoiding self-collision or slamming into the screen borders.

Each stage requires consuming a specific count of items to advance the level multiplier under a strict pool of five lives. The game features a clean, blocky terminal interface including a retro phosphor font header that tracks lives, high scores, and remaining targets, capturing the nostalgic aesthetic of a vintage IBM PC hobbyist program."

478512.overview:
Abenteuer Atlantis is a promotional game for the food manufacturer Knorr. You are playing as Knorrli who has to rescue his folk in Mesopotamia from starvation and epidemics. This evolves into a search after the legendary Atlantis.

It is played like many other adventure games: You search rooms after useful objects, use objects to solve puzzles and combine inventory items. There are only three commands - walk, use and speak - which can selected either with the mouse or the function keys. Knorrli automatic takes items when you click on them.

481624.overview: Released by Daewoo in 1994, this 16-tile mahjong game uses the most common Taiwanese playing style and scoring method, which should be quite familiar to mahjong enthusiasts in Taiwan. Unfortunately, it doesn't include features like "interlocking tiles," "edge tiles," and "single-tile wait" in the scoring options, even though these are common scoring methods in some parts of Taiwan. The game offers three modes: free-for-all, training mode, and mahjong tournament. It also features special items and spells, adding to the fun. Mahjong lovers should definitely give it a try; they'll surely enjoy it.

482723.overview: The apprentice Mot searches the land of Ruthaniol for three magical Eteron stones so that his master can summon the ancient demon Asmodeus. Explore from a first-person perspective, talk to characters, collect items and solve inventory puzzles. The adventure combines outdoor exploration with dungeon passages and real-time combat.
